selection_rule: T日收盘后使用历史截面和Aquant-Private/main打分，取Top-N；组合权重与生产portfolio.py完全一致。

return_definition: stateful close-to-close return, with T+1 open execution and overnight gaps

audit.intraday_return_definition: T+1 close equity / T+1 pre-trade open equity - 1
audit.constraint_comparison: same persistent portfolio and PIT signals, price limits enabled vs disabled; paused/missing-price restrictions remain
audit.cash_floor_scope: buy-side reserve; not a hard post-mark-to-market cash/equity ratio
